newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SocGen downgrades Swissair to neutral.
newsitem.headline: SocGen downgrades Swissair to neutral.

text.p: Analyst Dieter Winet of Societe Generale Equities & Derivatives Research has scaled back his rating of shares of Swissair AG and cut the earnings forecast.
The downgrade comes the day after Swissair announced that the loss in flight operations in 1996 would be higher than in 1995 due the erosion of fares and the rise in fuel costs.
Winet cut his earnings estimate for 1996 to a loss of 17 Swiss francs per share, or a 40 million franc net loss, from 1995's loss of 63.8 francs per share.
He also cut the earnings estimate for 1997 to 95 francs per share -- a 220 million franc profit -- from 117 francs.
Winet cut his rating of Swissair's registered shares to neutral from outperform, noting the shares rose 30 percent since July 1996, beating the 8.0 pecent rise in the blue-chip SPI.
The shares were also facing strong technical resistance at 1,360 francs, their all-time high, Winet said.
Winet noted that Swissair's traffic figures for 1996, which showed a load factor of 69.2 percent compared with 69.4 percent in 1995, were as expected.
Winet wrote the outcome in Swissair's flight operations is expected to be significantly worse than his estimate for a reduction in losses to 100 million francs.
Swissair does not publish results of flight operations, but it is widely believed it lost slightly more than 200 million francs in 1995.
Winet estimates the 1996 loss in flight operations could be around 220 million francs.
The effect of the larger loss is that Swissair will need to postpone its anticipated return to a break-even in flight operations to 1998 from 1997, Winet wrote.
Winet's new earnings estimate includes a write-down of Swissair's stake in Belgian carrier Sabena to zero. Swissair owns 49.5 percent of Sabena.

This represents a charge of 270 million francs on Swissair's 1996 account. The writedown also means that losses from Sabena, which Swissair consolidates on an equity basis, would be eliminated from from Swissair's accounts from 1997 onwards.
